sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Metamark is a manufacturer of sign vinyl, digital media, automotive films, and architectural films, established in 1992 and part of the UPM Group.

Industry: Materials Manufacturing · Size: not published · Products: MetaGrab MD5-UB, MetaStream, Automotive Ceramic Coating, MetaCast MDC XR, Metamark M7 Series, Sign Vinyl

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Metamark scores 29 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (24/25). Nothing was found for industry fit, company size and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (41% similar on films, vinyl, sign, media); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (41% similar on films, vinyl, wrap, vehicle); Drytac (30% similar on films, media, sign, vinyl). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
